title: Photography permits

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Clarify consent at the point of image production because the intended use changes what permission must be recorded.
strategic_value: A stated consent workflow can help Helsinki prepare photographs for their planned communications.
demonstration: This expanded webpage section presents marketing consent instructions, guardian and age conditions, a qualified news-use exception and a consent-form link.
practical_value: Identify the planned use and relevant signatories before commissioning or reusing a photograph.

content_islands.name: Marketing consent
content_islands.spec: State written consent and guardian/12–17-year-old signatures.

content_islands.name: Permission scope
content_islands.spec: List filming, publication and potential transfer.

content_islands.name: News-use qualification
content_islands.spec: Describe the source’s necessity, non-offensive-context and privacy conditions.

content_islands.name: Forms
content_islands.spec: Link to the official multilingual forms.

reference_purposes.Application: The source provides a workflow and links consent forms.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Marketing requires written consent; ages 12–17 sign alongside a guardian; the news-use exception is qualified by necessity, context and privacy.
